//: writing mutated copies of a module next to the real one — they have to sit
there so the module's own relative requires resolve — and deleting them
again. nodemon saw those files appear and restarted the dev server mid-test,
which killed whatever request the live integration suite had in flight and
failed it with a 502. A different test failed each run, none of them the one
writing the files, so it read as live-engine flakiness for a long time.
A test run must never restart the developer's server. Nothing here changes
what the server does; it changes what nodemon reacts to.
